title: Public portal: status, the member session, the member's signed-in devices, the member week, the member's own runs (answer, move, deep link, the party's characters), the member's weekly timings and their ownership, the member's requests, the member's own chat allowance, boss guides, and the member's own characters (roster, NEXON link and consent, My data, scouter lookups)

PublicStatus.description: The admin Config switch `self_service.public_portal`, read live.

PublicMember.description: The signed-in member as Discord reported them at sign-in: id, display name and avatar only (no email, banner or roles).

avatar.description: Same-origin portrait URL (`/api/public/session/avatar?v=<version>`); answers the monogram when the member has no avatar.

PublicSession.description: GET /api/public/session; the CSRF token travels in the `X-Kanade-CSRF` response header, never in the body.

fresh_until.description: When the fresh-write window of this session's last Discord round trip ends (ISO-8601 UTC); writes that need a fresh sign-in answer 401 `reauth_required` after it.

generated_at.description: The server's clock when this was read (ISO-8601 UTC).

PublicSessionRow.description: One live public session of the caller's Discord account; handle names it for sign-out. Ids, hashes, IP addresses and locations never leave the server.

device.description: Browser and system from the sign-in's User-Agent ("Firefox · Android"); null when unrecognised.

last_seen_at.description: Coarse: written at most once a minute.

current.description: The session this request came with.

MemberRun.description: One run as the signed-in member sees it: `week.json#/$defs/Run` minus `short_id`, `channel_id`, `cards`, `amended` and `roster_change`, plus `mine` and `can_edit`. Runs the member is not on are sent in full (drawn faded).

day.description: Day index from the boss-week reset day (0), in the guild zone; the admin week's `day`.

time.description: Guild-local start (`HH:MM`); null for an own-time run.

minutes.description: Configured sum of the run's boss durations, including own-time runs.

participants.description: Everyone on the run with name and answer, on every run (Q3).

channel.description: The channel name only; its id never leaves the server.

fixed_id.description: The weekly timing this run came from, or null.

mine.description: The signed-in member is a participant.

can_edit.description: `mine`, not `done` or `cancelled`, inside the current or next boss week. A UI hint only: every write re-authorizes per run.

MemberWeek.description: GET /api/public/week?week= (absent or `this`, `next`): the admin `Week` frame, run set and order, each run as `MemberRun`. `Cache-Control: no-store`.

starts.description: Local date of the boss week's reset day (YYYY-MM-DD).

reset.description: Weekday and local time of the reset (`Thu 00:00`).

generated_at.description: The server's clock when this was read (ISO-8601 UTC).

version.description: The schedule version the member's writes will send as their precondition.

MemberAllowance.description: GET /api/public/me/allowance: the signed-in member's own chat allowance and a coarse bot status; never another member's usage or queue entries. `Cache-Control: no-store`.

allowance.description: Answers allowed per window; null means no limit (staff). A member without chatbot access gets `count` 0 over the default window.

used.description: Answers counted in the current window (0 for staff).

resets_at.description: When the oldest counted answer leaves the window and `used` drops by one (ISO-8601 UTC, rounded up to the second, on the clock of `generated_at`); null for staff and when `used` is 0.

queue_position.description: The member's own queued chat call's 1-based position in its model group; null when none is waiting.

bot_busy.description: Coarse: some model group has every permit in use, so a new question would wait.

generated_at.description: The server's clock when this was read (ISO-8601 UTC).

MemberEventReady.description: GET /api/public/events (`text/event-stream`, not JSON; signed in, `503 closed` while the portal is, one member read token when it opens, `429 too_many_streams` past 3 streams per member or the overall cap): the `ready` event that opens every stream, after a `retry: 3000` line. A new `boot` means the server restarted. Hints sent while a stream was down are not replayed, so the client re-reads after every `ready` but the first. Heartbeats are `: keep-alive` comments; the stream ends on sign-out, sign-out everywhere, idle or absolute expiry, lost eligibility, the portal closing and after 5 minutes (the browser reconnects). Holding it open never extends the session.

MemberEventHint.description: One `message` event of GET /api/public/events: a topic only, never data, a sequence number or any member's id. `schedule`: the history head moved (re-read the week). `mine`: a change touched the member's own runs, answers or weekly timings, their requests or ownership asks (decided on the server; sent to that member only). `allowance`: their chat allowance changed.

MemberOwnerRequest.description: A request to own a weekly timing, as the signed-in member sees it. Answered by `POST /api/public/timings/{id}/owner-requests` (201, or 200 for a retry with the same Idempotency-Key) and `POST /api/public/owner-requests/{id}/accept|decline|withdraw`.

expires_at.description: 24 hours after `created_at` (ISO-8601 UTC); undecided, it then expires.

status.description: Always `open` in `MemberTiming.requests`; a write answers the request as it now is.

MemberTiming.description: A weekly timing the signed-in member is on, with its ownership. Also answers `POST /api/public/timings/{id}/owner`. Never the channel, note, short id or upcoming runs.

party.description: Everyone on the timing, in party order.

owner.description: The effective owner: the pinned owner, else the first party member.

owner_pinned.description: Ownership was handed on (or staff chose the owner); otherwise it follows the first party member.

you_own.description: The signed-in member is the owner.

requests.description: Open, unexpired requests to own it: all of them for its owner, otherwise only the member's own.

MemberTimings.description: GET /api/public/timings: the weekly timings the signed-in member is on (party only). `Cache-Control: no-store`.

generated_at.description: The server's clock when this was read (ISO-8601 UTC).

OwnerHandOff.description: Request body of `POST /api/public/timings/{id}/owner`: the party member who takes the timing; anything else is 422 `invalid_body`.

to.description: Discord user id (snowflake) of another party member.

MemberAnswer.description: Request body of `PUT /api/public/runs/{id}/answer`: the caller's own answer (no clear from the portal); anything else is 422 `invalid_body`.

version.description: `MemberWeek.version` the member saw; only a change to their own answer since then is 409 `stale`.

MemberMove.description: Request body of `POST /api/public/runs/{id}/move`: a new slot inside the run's (current) boss week; anything else is 422 `invalid_body`.

day.description: Day index from the boss-week reset day (0), as `MemberRun.day`.

time.description: Guild-local `HH:MM`; null only for an own-time run, which keeps its clock. An own-time run given a time moves to it (this week only).

version.description: `MemberWeek.version` the member saw; a change to the run's slot since then is 409 `stale`.

MemberRunResult.description: Answers `PUT /api/public/runs/{id}/answer`: the run as the member now sees it and the version to send next. A retry with the same Idempotency-Key answers the run as it is, writing nothing.

MemberMoveResult.description: Answers `POST /api/public/runs/{id}/move`; `previous` is where the run was before this move (a retry with the same Idempotency-Key answers the first move's).

MemberRunLink.description: GET /api/public/runs/{id}: the run a Discord link opens. 404 `not_found` unless the run is in this or next boss week or the member is or was on it. `Cache-Control: no-store`.

run.description: `can_edit` is false outside this and next boss week.

week.description: The run's boss week relative to now.

week_starts.description: Local date of that boss week's reset day (YYYY-MM-DD).

week_ends_at.description: The reset that ends that boss week (ISO-8601 UTC).

removed.description: The member was on this run and no longer is: who took them off (a member's name, `an admin` or `Kanade`) and when; null otherwise.

this_week.description: When `week` is `past`: this boss week's run of the same weekly timing, if any.

timing.description: The run's weekly timing slot, when it came from one.

generated_at.description: The server's clock when this was read (ISO-8601 UTC).

by.description: A member's display name, `an admin` or `Kanade`; never an administrator's id or label.

MemberRequestBody.description: Request body of `POST /api/public/requests`. join/leave/swap take `run_id` xor `fixed_id` (runs of this and next boss week only), swap also `with`; change_fixed takes `fixed_id` and any of `day`, `time`, `channel_id`, `party`; new_fixed takes `day`, `time`, `channel_id`, `bosses` and optionally `party` (the requester always leads it). A field the kind does not take is 422 `field_not_allowed`; anything else malformed, or outside `MemberRequests.options`, is 422 `invalid_body`.

with.description: The member taking the requester's place (an `options.members` id).

note.description: Free text for the admins, trimmed; at most 200 characters, no control characters.

MemberRequest.description: One of the member's requests. Answers `POST /api/public/requests` (201, or 200 for a retry with the same Idempotency-Key) and `POST /api/public/requests/{id}/withdraw`.

state.description: `expired` once its boss week has passed, even before the expiry tick closes it.

summary.description: The generated public summary admins see (`member request: join run:<id>`).

note.description: The member's note, if they wrote one.

run.description: The run it is about, as the member sees it now; null for weekly timings and runs that are gone.

fixed_id.description: The weekly timing it is about.

with.description: Swap: who takes the requester's place.

proposed.description: new_fixed and change_fixed: the asked-for slot; null fields are left as they are.

decided_at.description: When it was approved, rejected, withdrawn or closed as expired (ISO-8601 UTC).

expires_at.description: The reset that closes its boss week (ISO-8601 UTC); null for weekly-timing requests, which never expire.

edited.description: Approved with changes by an admin; `proposed` then shows what was approved.

not_approved.description: What an edited approval left out, in the member's words (`the party change`).

channels.description: Watched channels this and next boss week's runs or the weekly timings use, `{id, name}`.

members.description: Every member with the bossing role (swap partners, weekly parties).

MemberRequests.description: GET /api/public/requests/mine: the member's own requests, newest first, with the limits and the form's choices. `Cache-Control: no-store`.

open.description: Undecided requests, as the `open` limit counts them.

today.description: Requests sent in the last 24 hours (withdrawn ones count), as the `today` limit counts them.

generated_at.description: The server's clock when this was read (ISO-8601 UTC).

MemberRequestLimit.description: The 429 body of `POST /api/public/requests` over a limit: `error.json#/$defs/ApiError` plus which limit refused.

PublicKnowledge.description: GET /api/public/bosses/{key}/knowledge: `bosses.json` `Knowledge` without `path`, and with no bullet's chatbot-only `detail` (public-portal-plan Q8). The list (`GET /api/public/bosses`) and event bosses (`GET /api/public/bosses/events`) are `bosses.json` `BossRows` and `EventBosses` unchanged. `Cache-Control: no-store`.

WithoutDetail.description: Any JSON value with no object, at any depth, holding a `detail` key.

MyCharacters.description: GET /api/public/me/characters (module `roster`): the caller's own roster rows (active and retired, as the admin's `MemberCharacters` lists them), each one's link by character id and the links waiting for them to confirm, oldest first. Without module `character_data`, `links` is empty and `pending` too. `Cache-Control: no-store`.

links.description: Keyed by character id; every character has one while module `character_data` is on.

pending.description: "Waiting for you": the member's links waiting for them to confirm the current notice (admins' links are active at once).

character_data.description: Module `character_data` is on (links, notice, My data).

connected.description: A NEXON key is configured: Add looks up, links can be made, class and level may be left out for MapleSEA.

privacy_url.description: The public /privacy page; null without a public listener.

PendingLink.description: A link waiting for the member to confirm: who put it there (the sweeper after a new notice) and when it lapses (14 days).

requested_by_name.description: An admin requester's member name when they signed in with Discord (requests left from before admins' links went active at once); null otherwise.

MyCharacterCreate.description: Body of POST /api/public/me/characters: `characters.json#/$defs/CharacterCreate` for the caller. `class` and `level` are required (422 `class_level_required`) unless the character is MapleSEA and NEXON is connected.

MyCharacterCreated.description: `201` answer of POST /api/public/me/characters: the row as stored plus `linkable` (MapleSEA with NEXON connected: the portal opens the notice next). No link request is made.

MyCharacterPatch.description: Body of PATCH /api/public/me/characters/{id}: `characters.json#/$defs/CharacterPatch` for one of the caller's characters.

MemberLookupRequest.description: Body of POST /api/public/me/characters/lookup: a MapleSEA IGN as typed.

LinkNotice.description: GET /api/public/me/characters/{id}/link/notice: the `/character link` notice (version `version`) word for word as plain text, for one of the caller's active MapleSEA characters that is not linked; `request` is the link waiting for them, when there is one. 404 for another member's character, 409 `not_connected`/`retired`/`already_linked`, 422 `region`.

as_is.description: Followed by the Privacy notice link.

attribution.const: Data based on NEXON Open API

LinkConfirm.description: Body of POST /api/public/me/characters/{id}/link: the notice version the member read.

LinkOutcome.description: POST /api/public/me/characters/{id}/link: the consent is recorded (surface `portal`) and the first fetch runs, as Discord's Link. `linked` with data; `linked_later`: linked, the data comes with the next refresh; `busy`: the daily NEXON budget cannot cover it (nothing kept); `unavailable`: calls are held (nothing kept); `not_found`: NEXON has no such character (nothing kept); `other_region`: not a MapleSEA character.

LinkCancelled.description: POST /api/public/me/characters/{id}/link/cancel: nothing changes; a link waiting for the member stays waiting (`request_kept`).

Unlinked.description: DELETE /api/public/me/characters/{id}/link: the link and its data are deleted in one write; `cards` share cards are being cleared.

UnlinkedAll.description: DELETE /api/public/me/characters/links: every link of the caller's, deleted at once (empty when nothing was linked).

SharedCard.description: A tracked `/character share` card: its channel's name (never the id), when it was posted and when it is cleared.

notice.description: The notice version the member consented to; null while pending and for an admin's link.

consent_surface.description: Where the consent was given; null while pending, for an admin's link and for consents before it was recorded.

MyData.description: GET /api/public/me/data (`/character data`): everything kept for the caller, requests waiting for them first, then the active main, other active characters and retired ones, each group by IGN (case-insensitive); MapleSEA characters with nothing kept are `not_linked`. `Cache-Control: no-store`.

attribution.const: Data based on NEXON Open API

MemberEstimateRequest.description: Body of POST /api/public/me/estimates: one of the caller's characters; `refresh` skips the 24-hour memory (Look up again).

MemberEstimateLimit.description: The 429 body of POST /api/public/me/estimates within 30 minutes of the caller's last counted lookup start: `error.json#/$defs/ApiError` plus when the next may start. A failed lookup does not count.

PartyCharacter.description: The character a party member brings: roster values, except on the caller's own slot, whose level is the fresh NEXON level when linked (`level_source: nexon`, `as_of`). No combat power, no verdicts.

PartyEstimate.description: One boss of the run: the character's cached scouter reading (`character_data.json#/$defs/ScouterReading` plus the boss).

character.description: null: no character on the roster.

scouter.description: Per boss of the run from the 24-hour memory (empty: no lookup in the last 24 h); null with estimates off or no character.

PartyTotal.description: The party total for one boss of the run, as the admin's Estimate panel shows it (`EstimateJob.result.combined[]` without its issues).

combined_percentage.description: The sum of the found members' effective %; null unless every member found has one.

complete.description: false with a missing or failed member or an unknown share.

PartyTotals.description: The run's newest finished party lookup (an admin's Look up party), from the 24-hour memory; never looked up here.

fetched_at.description: When kanade received it from the scouter.

bosses.description: The run's bosses it has a total for, in run order.

RunPartyCharacters.description: GET /api/public/runs/{id}/characters (module `roster`): on a run the caller is on, the character each party member brings (the run's pick, else its timing's pick, else the main, else the only one), its cached scouter readings and the run's party totals. Never another member's NEXON data or link state. 404 `not_found` for anyone not on the run, as for a run that does not exist. `Cache-Control: no-store`.

totals.description: null while estimates are off, or without a finished lookup of this run's party in the last 24 hours (or when its total failed).

nexon_data.description: The caller's own slot shows NEXON data: show `attribution` with it.

attribution.const: Data based on NEXON Open API
